title.zh: 回覆研討會的演講細節

subtitle: 原創模擬題（多益寫作風格）：回覆電子郵件，提供兩項資訊並提出一個請求
task:
Directions: Read the e-mail below. Respond to the e-mail as if you are Henry Tsai. In your e-mail, give TWO pieces of information about your presentation and make ONE request.

From: Rachel Moore, Program Coordinator, Asia Retail Forum
To: Henry Tsai
Subject: Your presentation at the Asia Retail Forum

Dear Mr. Tsai,

We are delighted that you have agreed to speak at the Asia Retail Forum in Singapore on September 9. To help us prepare the program and the room, please send us some details about your presentation.

Best regards,
Rachel Moore
taskZh: 你（Henry Tsai）答應在 9 月 9 日新加坡的 Asia Retail Forum 演講，主辦單位的 Rachel Moore 來信請你提供演講的細節，方便安排議程和場地。請回信提供兩項關於演講的資訊，並提出一個請求。
focus: 任務完成：兩項資訊與一個請求都要明確，時間、設備等細節具體
組織：用 First、Second 列出資訊，請求另起一段並說明理由
語氣：專業而有禮，請求用 would it be possible 等委婉說法
文法與用字：分詞片語、未來式與商業用語正確

en: Thank you for inviting me to speak at the Asia Retail Forum. I am honored to take part and happy to share the details of my presentation. First, my talk is titled "How Small Shops Can Compete Online," and it will last about 40 minutes, followed by a 10-minute question-and-answer session. Second, I will be showing several short videos, so the room will need a projector with speakers.

I would also like to make one request. Because some of the audience may be new to online selling, would it be possible to share my slides with participants a few days before the forum? I can send the file to you by August 30 if this is acceptable. Please let me know whether this would work for your team.
Best regards, Henry Tsai, Marketing Director, Lantern Home Goods
zh: 謝謝您邀請我在 Asia Retail Forum 演講。能夠參與我深感榮幸，也很樂意提供演講的細節。第一，我的講題是「小商店如何在網路上競爭」，演講約 40 分鐘，之後有 10 分鐘的問答時間。第二，我會播放幾段短片，所以會場需要一台附喇叭的投影機。
另外，我想提出一個請求。由於有些聽眾可能剛接觸網路銷售，請問能否在論壇前幾天先把我的投影片分享給與會者？如果可以的話，我能在 8 月 30 日前把檔案寄給您。請告訴我這樣是否方便貴團隊作業。
Lantern Home Goods 行銷總監 蔡亨利 敬上
